<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Take Flight](/Feats.aspx?ID=5304) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Awakened Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=787" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 25

**Frequency**
once per round

**Prerequisites**
[Flying Animal](/Heritages.aspx?ID=289) heritage

</column>

---

Though it's not fully effective, much of your ability to fly has stayed with you. You [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312). If you don't normally have a fly Speed, you gain a fly Speed of 15 feet for this movement. If you aren't on solid ground at the end of this movement, you fall.

<title level="2">Take Flight leads to...</title>
[Strong of Wing](/Feats.aspx?ID=5311)
name: Take Flight
